title: Assignment 2 - Municipal Issues Policy Paper
description:
Choose one of the following topics: Power and Politics (strong mayor systems), Municipal Policy (policy makers vs policy takers), Municipalities and the Constitution, Representation and Size of Council, Representation and Elections, Community Connection and Engagement, or Other Topic (with instructor approval).

  Requirements:
  - Formal essay format, 1800-2400 words (6-8 pages), double spaced, 11-12pt font
  - APA referencing
  - At least 5 course sources (readings, content, discussions)
  - At least 3 non-course academic/peer-reviewed sources
  - Must take a clear position with supporting evidence

  Structure: Introduction (thesis/position), Body (background, main points with evidence), Conclusion (summary, implications)

  Grading: 10 marks (introduction/issue description), 14 marks (position/evidence/justification), 6 marks (organization/references/citations)

  Worth 30% of final course grade.
  Due: End of Week 10, Friday 11:59 pm.
